item: Q3 2026 results from Centuri, Quanta, MasTec, MYR, Primoris, Mistras and Team
why: Tests whether MSA margins hold (Centuri's guide is $280-310M adj. EBITDA) and whether specialty margins (Mistras 12.6%) keep improving.
Shows whether the 2026-27 consumption forecasts (4,288 / 4,356 BkWh) hold.

item: Grid Strategies' next national load-growth report
why: Shows whether the 166 GW five-year forecast rises again, or the ~25 GW data-center overstatement is corrected.

item: PHMSA gas leak detection and repair proposed rule
why: Publication would restore a federal driver for leak survey and repair work, the core of a gas compliance add-on strategy.

item: FY2027 Clean Water and Drinking Water SRF appropriations
why: First year without IIJA supplemental money ($2,603M per fund in FY2026); shows how deep the water funding cliff is.
Confirms or reverses the slowdown (net international migration projected at ~321k for 2026).

item: D.C. Circuit decision in AWWA v. EPA on LCRI (argued 2026-09-30)
why: Decides whether private-side lead-line replacement stands. Sets the timing of the water entry and of Imperial's lead and brass flows.
First read on whether solar and wind additions peak after the OBBBA credit phase-out.
Base gross margin trend (6.9% in 2024, 8.0% in 2025) is the best public read on gas and electric MSA economics.

item: UGI's target date to finish cast-iron main replacement
why: Shows utility programs shifting from cast iron to bare steel and vintage plastic, which is the durable work.

item: Palisades return to service (fuel load paused in Aug 2026)
why: Execution test for nuclear restarts (~2.25 GW across three plants) and the outage-services niche.

item: Sponsor exits in lower-middle-market utility services (Sparus held by Ridgemont since 2021; reported USG Water Solutions sale)
why: Sets the prices FAM will face for platforms and add-ons. Above ~9-10x, slow down.

item: PHMSA CY2026 gas distribution annual-report data
why: Re-pull the by-decade inventory and cast-iron mileage to finalize the deck's mains-over-50-years statistic.

item: Artera refinancing, rating actions or asset sales
why: Distress could release gas assets (Miller Pipeline, Minnesota Limited) as carve-outs. Deeper distress is a warning about MSA economics.

item: Crane Clean Energy Center restart and Nine Mile Point 1 license renewal
why: More nuclear life extension supports NDE and testing add-ons.

item: EEI actual capex against the ~$207.9B 2025 projection
why: EEI says first-year projections run high. This confirms the size of the T&D pool.
Starts the 10-year lead-line replacement clock to ~2037.

item: EIA outlook with full-year 2027 electricity consumption
why: Tests the 4,356 BkWh forecast and the data-center-led growth story.

item: Data-center electricity use against LBNL's 325-580 TWh range for 2028
why: Shows whether large-load growth is real enough to extend asset lives and raise maintenance intensity, or stays a construction story.
